title: ENSA engineering students’ course boycott and January 18 meeting
reason: The opened report documents an academic course boycott that began in November 2020 and an administrative meeting on Jan 18, but no public gathering. A class boycott/meeting alone does not meet the public-gathering event criterion.
notes: The boycott and policy demands remain useful context; do not treat the ministry meeting’s participants as protest attendance.

title: Peugeot workers’ factory work stoppage in Oulad Bourahma, Kenitra
reason: The opened weekly reports a Peugeot-Citroën factory work stoppage in Kenitra on Jan 27. It also says the provincial governor visited and talks were held between management and worker representatives, but it documents no public assembly; a strike and mediation alone do not establish a qualifying public gathering.
notes: The grievances concerned wages, social-security registration, coverage, overtime and related workplace conditions. Keep the Jan 27 factory stoppage distinct from the Khenifra dismissal protest (E010); the factory account is in Kenitra. The governor’s mediation is not coded as a response to a documented public gathering.
